content:
This week, we're updating everyone again on the latest additions to Apple's official certified refurbished store. This week's highlights include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

Apple's certified refurbished store is a great way to save money, letting you buy directly from Apple's official website while saving up to 15%.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Quality guaranteed, attractive prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before sale
  • Comes with Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Eligible for Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare service available for additional purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and removal at Apple's certified refurbished store so you don't have to search yourself. Inventory changes quickly, and the purpose of this article is to keep you updated on the latest availability so you can snag your desired product before it sells out.

Mac computers

Among these, the MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain my top value picks. Whether you're joining the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrading to a product with Apple's custom silicon, both are excellent choices.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo 256GB storage: $599 (originally $699 for new)
  • MacBook Neo 512GB storage with Touch ID: $679 (originally $799 for new)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, 512GB storage and 16GB RAM: $1,099 (originally $1,299 for new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, 1TB storage and 16GB RAM: $1,529 (originally $1,799 for new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, 2TB storage and 16GB RAM: $1,949 (originally $2,299 for new)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac, 256GB storage and 16GB RAM: $1,269 (originally $1,499 for new)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac, 512GB storage and 16GB RAM: $1,439 (originally $1,699 for new)

Studio Display

A few weeks ago, we first reported that the Studio Display XDR had appeared in Apple's refurbished store. As always, I must remind everyone that inventory can change at any time, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299 for new)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599 for new)

Apple TV 4K

The ever-popular base model Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, and the higher-end model with Ethernet connectivity is also available. The base model typically sells out quickly, so if you're interested, don't hesitate.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) 64GB storage, Wi-Fi version: $169 (originally $199 for new)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet version: $209 (originally $249 for new)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you're considering getting one, Apple's refurbished store has some good deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black Ocean band: $679 (originally $799 for new)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with anchor blue Ocean band: $679 (originally $799 for new)

As always, you can visit the 9to5Toys website to stay on top of the latest Apple deals all week long.
